# vendor/

`evidence_kit/`: pinned copy of `../evidence-kit/evidence_kit` (version **5.2.0**), copied 2026-10-04 per the series rule
"copy, don't link" (it replaces the 4.1.0 copy of 2026-09-30; 5.x only adds to the article components the build uses:
`proof_strip`, `reality`, `evidence_bar`, `refresh`, `figure_footer`, and `evidence_kit.publication`, the local-path scan
every build now runs). The POC vendors the same version for its proof pack (`production_agentic_ai_platform/vendor/`).
